segments.en: Hello.
Hello.
Hello.
Where are you from?
I am from Mumbai, and where are you from?
I am also from Mumbai.
Where in Mumbai do you live?
I live in Thane.
Okay, I live in Vashi.
Okay, can I be your ATM?
What can you be?
ATM.
ATM?
Yes.
Sorry, how is that possible? I am hearing this for the first time.
Actually, we, I mean, we will always, whenever you need anything, or need to do some shopping, we will do it for you.
What will you do?
Whenever you need to do some shopping, we will do the shopping for you.
Oh, so in return, what is the benefit for you?
I will just talk to you on WhatsApp, that's it.
Thank you so much, but I am sorry, I can't accept it because I am a one-time user and I am in the medical field.
What, what?
What do you do for a living?
I have my own shop.
What kind of shop do you have?
A food and beverage shop.
Food and beverage shop? Okay, by the way, thank you so much for your opportunity, but I am sorry, I earn 2 lakhs, so I know how to do my own shopping.
If you earn 2 lakhs, then why are you here? Tell me.
I am here, actually, I am confused whether I should get married or not, and my parents are forcing me to get married, and I have no interest in marriage, so I wanted to know...
I just need one friend, that's it.
If you are a friend, then I can be your friend, no doubt.
So we will do everything for you, that's it.
Don't do anything, just talk to me and give me advice.
Okay, what kind of...
Sorry, your voice is breaking.
I said, can I give you my number?
No thanks, I won't call you.
Okay, no problem.
Are you married or unmarried?
Yes, unmarried.
Okay, tell me more about yourself.
That's it, I just wanted to say that, nothing else.
Okay, don't say that to anyone, otherwise anyone will take you as an ATM and go shopping.
So it will work, right? What do I care? I just need a friend, that's it.
That's wrong. If you are a friend, then be a friend, but don't be anyone's ATM or Paytm, because...
I want to be, I get happiness from it, and what else?
You get happiness, but she will ruin you and leave you, look at the current times, it's like that.
I don't care about all that.
Ah, it turns out she will roam with you, and for money, she will roam with someone else, so what is the benefit of that?
I don't care about that, I just need a partner, that's it, let anything happen, what do I care?
Do you need a partner or a friend?
The same thing, friend and partner are the same thing, oh man.
No, no, no, both are different.
No, no.
A partner is for a lifetime, a friend is limited to being a friend. A partner is someone who walks with us for a lifetime, that is a partner, a life partner.
Yes, so I just need that, nothing else.
If you want a life partner, then don't look here, I can tell you clearly.
Okay, okay, fine.
Okay.
No problem.
Yes, and don't do this money thing.
